name: work-pets
description: Create and manage animated companion pets that appear inside ChatGPT Work mode.

interface.shortDescription: Create and manage animated ChatGPT pets, not real-world or other-app pets.
interface.longDescription: Create, preview, list, select, update, download, and delete animated companions that appear inside ChatGPT Work mode. This plugin is for ChatGPT Pets, not real-world pet recommendations, adoption, care, generic pet images, or pets in other games and apps.
